business_summary: DBG Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides electronics manufacturing services in China and internationally. It offers smart consumer terminals, automotive electronics, communication devices, digital new energy, AI and computing devices, and medical electronics. The company also provides automation, automated optical and x-ray inspection, performance test, and lean manufacturing services. In addition, it engages in investment activities; research and development consulting; software development; engineering; and wholesale trade. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Huizhou, China.
